name: RF door opens
first_frame: A clean, modern robotics research lab seen from just inside its entrance. Pale concrete floor, white walls, and a ceiling of exposed cable trays with linear LED fixtures. In the far wall stands a closed grey steel shielded door with a recessed handle and a small amber status light beside it. Nobody is in the room.
lighting: Cool, even overhead LED light with soft floor reflections; the amber status light gives a small warm accent.
view: Eye-level view from just inside the entrance, looking straight down the room toward the shielded door in the far wall.

subjects.name: Shielded door
subjects.attribute: Grey steel RF-shielded door, hinged on its left edge, with a recessed handle.

events.description: The room is still and the door is closed while the view holds.
The door unlatches and swings inward on its left hinges until it stands fully open, revealing a darker corridor beyond; the status light turns from amber to green as it opens.

actions.action: unlatches and swings inward on its left hinges until it stands fully open.
